name: bitcoin-stratigraphy-mcp
title: Bitcoin Stratigraphy Data Engine
description: Read-only, unauthenticated connection metadata for 16 canonical tools. Loading this file never creates an invoice or executes a tool.

sse.note: Advertise both JSON and SSE for Streamable HTTP client compatibility. This server returns JSON for POST; GET /mcp is a finite discovery probe, not an SSE session. The paid REST SSE telemetry feed is a separate API.

handshake.note: The server also supports stateless MCP 2026-07-28 with per-request _meta and matching Mcp-Method, Mcp-Name, and MCP-Protocol-Version headers. Use the full discovery document and connection guide for that request contract.

l402.required_for: Paid tool execution only; loading discovery and protocol handshakes is free.

authorization.preimage: 64 hexadecimal characters whose SHA-256 matches the exact invoice payment hash.
authorization.binding: Use the macaroon from the exact challenge and the matching paid invoice preimage; never mix credentials from different challenges.

l402.preflight: New invoice requests first require the server's one-use SHA-256 proof of work. Submit the intended JSON-RPC body; follow error.data.proof_of_work or proof_of_work in HTTP 400, then retry the identical body with X-L402-PoW-Challenge and X-L402-PoW-Nonce. Only then pay the returned HTTP 402 challenge using an authorized Lightning wallet and retry with Authorization. Existing paid credential verification requires no new proof of work.
l402.wallet_policy: Require an L402-capable wallet wrapper and explicit spending limits. Discovery never authorizes spending; never publish wallet secrets or preimages.

pricing.requirement: Exactly two sandbox tools are free; all other tools require verified L402 settlement. Prices below are indicative base sats; obtain a live quote before payment.

ai_treasury_yield.label: 21% algorithmic yield
ai_treasury_yield.basis: Conditional allocation of gross settled qualifying invoices, not an investment yield or extra merchant fee.
ai_treasury_yield.eligibility: Requires qualifying paid routing and independently verified provider-bound payout addresses. Ordinary allocation is 21% direct or 14% direct plus 7% parent; qualifying verification uses 15% upstream plus 6% caller. Unverified addresses remain pending; no automatic Lightning payouts or guaranteed returns.

compliance.framework: EU AI Act Article 12 compliance support
capabilities: Trace-context logging and offline receipt verification
compliance.limits: Audit evidence supports organizational compliance workflows; it is not regulatory certification, legal advice, proof of actual agent reasoning, or proof of compliance. Calendar acceptance and Bitcoin confirmation are distinct.

tools.name: stratigraphy.get
tools.description: Retrieve indexed Bitcoin stratigraphy and telemetry.

tools.name: stratigraphy.get_digest
tools.description: Return a compressed, source-grounded stratigraphy digest.

tools.name: stratigraphy.get_range
tools.description: Retrieve a selected historical range; optionally deliver the result by signed webhook.

tools.name: stratigraphy.list
tools.description: Discover available indexed strata and range metadata; free sandbox capability.

tools.name: proof.attenuate
tools.description: Narrow an existing macaroon's authority with supported delegation caveats.

tools.name: proof.verify
tools.description: Verify supplied supported cryptographic proof or OpenTimestamps evidence.

tools.name: proof.get_by_hash
tools.description: Look up a registered proof record by hash.

tools.name: proof.list
tools.description: Discover proof lifecycle/status records; free sandbox capability.

tools.name: proof.submit
tools.description: Submit proof evidence for processing; optionally receive a signed webhook result.

tools.name: proof.notarize

tools.name: mesh.broadcast
tools.description: Broadcast supported signed evidence to the configured Nostr peer mesh.
